acceptance: Journey, red first: a fake pane idle at its prompt with no deliverable gets the nudge after the grace, not after ArtifactTimeoutS.
A busy pane with no deliverable still waits the full interval.
A pane that writes the deliverable inside the grace completes with no nudge.
Docs: the bridge package note and interaction-protocol.md change in STE; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: When the liveness center reports the pane idle at its prompt (not busy) for a policy-set grace (for example 180 s) and the completion detector is not ready, run the checkpoint disposition at once (the existing one-shot nudge) and not at the end of the interval. A busy pane keeps the full interval. The grace lives in policy.json, not in code.
summary: Each stop-review checkpoint waits the full interval cfg.ArtifactTimeoutS (default tmuxArtifactTimeoutS, 1200 s; go/internal/bridge/driver_tmux_wait_state.go newReplWaitState) even when the liveness center already reports the pane idle at its prompt (LIVENESS_PHASE_STALLED '... (idle at its prompt)' after 10 min). Cycles 2200-2355 hold 17 idle nudges; 12 ended with artifact_appeared, mostly 0-1 min after the nudge, so each cost about 20 minutes of lane time with the agent done and waiting. Cycle 2352 audit: report written 11:23Z, first checkpoint 11:42Z.
title: A pane that is idle at its prompt with no deliverable gets its checkpoint before the full artifact timeout
